title: BFC Float Enclosure & Margin Collapse Sandbox
description: Toggle display: flow-root in a live rendering context to observe float enclosure and top-margin isolation.
html:
Outer Reference Frame (top: 0)
float: left
First child (margin-top)
js: var p = document.getElementById('parent'); var r = document.getElementById('readout'); if (p && r) { var rect = p.getBoundingClientRect(); var cs = getComputedStyle(p); r.textContent = 'display: ' + cs.display + ' | parent height: ' + Math.round(rect.height) + 'px | offsetTop: ' + p.offsetTop + 'px'; }
expectedObservation: With display: flow-root off, the floated box protrudes below the parent border and the first child's margin-top escapes outside the parent. Enabling display: flow-root establishes a new Block Formatting Context: the parent expands to enclose the float and traps the top margin internally.
